text: Ruins of the Old City of Badin Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Ruins of the Old City of Badin Type: Archaeological Site - Settlement Province: Sindh District: Badin Period: Historic Relative Chronology: Early 8th Century - 1857 CE Description: The ancient town of Badin now in complete ruins and encroached upon by modern buildings existed during the mature phase of the Indus Valley Civilization and it went through many ups and downs through its chequered history and was reportedly destroyed by Mohsin Khan Pathan towards the end of the 18th century CE.
